title: Playing the district during Lent
summary: During Lent Catholics didn't dance so bands worked the district.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Did you play much in the district? During lunch.

During lunch. You could get a job any time you want. Mm-hmm. All you're walking out your band look and see there's no band. Say, where you guys going here? You want to work here? I don't know. What you paying? A dollar and I'd go. You kept eating, you know. But you could buy so much for the dollar and a half. And you pick up probably dollar and a half tip sometimes.
You mean you only work in the district during Lent? Why is that?
Catholic time there. The Catholics didn't dance. During Lent? Yeah.
Oh, I see. Everything shut down.
He didn't want to just stand in the district like
They're good Catholics. They start dancing Sunday night.
